checkpoints.title: Pulivendula from OSM, playable end to end
checkpoints.goal: The menu offers a town picker (pincode removed); choosing Pulivendula plays both modes on a map built by World.buildTown from data/towns/pulivendula.json, produced offline by scripts/osm-to-town.js from data/osm/pulivendula.osm.gz. playwright-core devDependency and npm run e2e exist.
done_when: scripts/osm-to-town.js converts the fixture and the Pulivendula export with no dependencies; data/osm/pulivendula.osm.gz and data/towns/pulivendula.json are committed
World.buildTown replaces generateTown; Pulivendula passes the map invariants; the bot completes both modes there
the menu has a town picker instead of the pincode field; client/pincode.js and test/pincode.test.js are gone; render follows map.roads
npm run e2e loads the page, picks Pulivendula, starts Nomination Day and sees the game running with no requests to other sites; commands.e2e is set in forge
npm test and design_check pass

checkpoints.title: Kadapa and Punganur, landmarks, credit
checkpoints.goal: All three towns are playable from the picker, with real bus and police stations and OSM neighbourhood names placed from the data, and the new disclaimer with the OpenStreetMap credit.
done_when: data/osm/{kadapa,punganur}.osm.gz and data/towns/{kadapa,punganur}.json are committed; Kadapa is cropped to the old town
all three towns pass the map invariants and the bot completes both modes in each
mapped bus stations and police stations inside the square appear at their real positions; labels use OSM place names
the disclaimer text and data/towns/README.md (ODbL) are in place; the menu passes the keyboard, contrast and 375 px checks

checkpoints.title: TDP mob with stones, police escort
checkpoints.goal: YSRCP and TDP are the parties; goons are TDP workers in yellow; TDP mobs throw stones that tear papers, scatter supporters and stun the candidate; police near a rioting mob escort it and target the crowd; a big crowd drives a mob back; the fan flag is drawn.
done_when: stone, police-escort, crowd-vs-mob and determinism tests pass
Content has PARTY = YSRCP and RIVAL = TDP with original lines; no real person's name in any line
render draws yellow shirts, the YSRCP fan flag, the TDP flag and stones

checkpoints.title: Arson of supporters' houses and vehicles
checkpoints.goal: Some houses are YSRCP supporters' homes and parked vehicles stand near them and the party office; mobs set only those on fire; a fire blocks its tiles for 20 s and paths route around it; flames, smoke and charred remains are drawn.
done_when: arson target, blocking/freeing and routing tests pass
render draws supporter roof flags, vehicles, flames, smoke and charred remains

checkpoints.title: Town ally and TDP leader
checkpoints.goal: Each town has an invented YSRCP ally at the party office who joins with 6 supporters, halves stone damage and shortens the counter hold, and an invented TDP leader who heads the largest mob near the target.
done_when: ally and leader tests pass in all three towns
every Content line fills its placeholders
render draws name tags and distinct looks for ally and leader

checkpoints.title: Scrutiny ending: 10 filed, 6 torn, 4 accepted
checkpoints.goal: In nomination mode, finishing the counter hold starts a scrutiny phase where the TDP mob storms the RO office, 6 nominations are snatched and torn, and the run ends won with 10 filed, 6 torn, 4 accepted, shown in a panel that respects reduced motion.
done_when: scrutiny sim test passes; Polling Day ends as before
e2e shows the scrutiny panel text and no animation under reduced motion
npm test, npm run e2e and design_check pass

checkpoints.title: Readability and accessibility polish
checkpoints.goal: Fix the feature-level design critique's majors and cheap minors: long toasts and speech bubbles wrap instead of overflowing or squeezing; the mode buttons expose their selected state to assistive tech and show a non-colour cue; the scrutiny panel fits short landscape screens; TDP yellow is not confused with ambient autos; reduced motion also stops stone/fire shakes; focus returns to Play after a run; scrutiny copy uses 'nominations'.
done_when: toasts and speech bubbles wrap onto extra lines within the viewport/bubble width with no horizontal text compression (fillText maxWidth no longer squeezes)
Nomination Day / Polling Day buttons carry aria-pressed (or radio semantics) that tracks the selection, plus a non-colour selected cue
the scrutiny panel's buttons are reachable without hidden overflow at 667x375 and 320x568

ambient autos no longer use TDP-like yellow; stone and fire screen shakes respect prefers-reduced-motion; focus returns to Play after any run; panel note and menu result line read correctly after the scrutiny
npm test, npm run e2e and design_check pass
